title: Most of it is little tools I...
content_text:
Most of it is little tools I built for myself and endless tinkering on my notes repo — no real portfolio pieces, nothing that actually makes money.
I even let my workout habit slip.
Going forward, I need to stick to things with certain payoffs — studying English daily, slowly building the exercise habit back.
Take more small steps toward freelancing, instead of worrying about whether it'll work first.
